page.overview:
Who is Elias?

was the half-elven son of Zerxus Ilerez, who adopted him after marrying his father, Evandrin Alterra. As an NPC, Elias was played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Elias was a half-elf teenager with red hair. He looked like a younger version of his father, Evandrin. By the eve of the Calamity he looked gawky and a little awkward.

Elias was an affectionate son who, due to the grief of losing one of his parents, and the fact that the other had to live in a different city due to his job, became somehow resentful towards Zerxus, avoiding contacting him, although he regretted that decision the very same day.

Elias was the son of Evandrin Alterra, an Eldritch Knight that moved to Avalir when his son was still a baby. Shortly thereafter, he met and married Zerxus Ilerez, who fell in love with the knight and loved Elias as his own son, so the couple raised the child together.
